name: @mandusec/dashboard
description: Mandu observability dashboard: the privileged human view of a DualView session. Serves the canonical ManduEvent stream (file-backed now, arbiter-SSE later) and a vanilla-JS frontend with three DualView lanes, side-by-side symbolized/original call detail, T-LLM vs U-LLM, a symbol inspector, an invariant/oracle banner, and a read-only egress queue. Implements docs/design/ui/dashboard.md. Frontend render logic lifted/adapted from adfi-openclaw test/dashboard (see file PROVENANCE headers).
